# criblio_instance_settings (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_instance_settings" "my_instancesettings" {
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `instance_settings_schema1` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1))
- `instance_settings_schema2` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema2))

<a id="nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.instance_settings_schema1`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_workspace` (Attributes) Cribl.Cloud Workspace connection settings, when the Node is managed by a Cribl.Cloud Leader. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace))
- `env_regex` (String) Regular expression used to filter environment variable names included in system information responses.
- `group` (String) Unique identifier for the Worker Group or Edge Fleet the Node belongs to.
- `master` (Attributes) Leader Node connection settings for Distributed deployments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--master))
- `mode` (String) Distribution mode of the Cribl instance.
- `reported_deployment_id` (String) Deployment identifier reported to the Leader for tracking purposes.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with this instance for categorization and routing.

<a id="nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.instance_settings_schema1.cloud_workspace`

Read-Only:

- `auth_token` (String) Authentication token that the Node uses to connect to the Leader.
- `auth_token_rotated` (Boolean) When <code>true</code>, merged settings prefer <code>authToken</code> from instance configuration over userinfo embedded in <code>CRIBL_DIST_MASTER_URL</code>. Set when the Leader rotates the Node token via RESTProxy.
- `compression` (String) Compression algorithm applied to data sent to the Leader.
- `config_bundles` (Attributes) Configuration bundle settings for fetching remote config bundles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace--config_bundles))
- `config_helper_socket_dir` (String) Filesystem path to the directory used for config helper socket files.
- `connection_timeout` (Integer) Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait when establishing a connection to the Leader.
- `disable_sni_routing` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, disable SNI-based routing for this connection. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, disable the Cribl.Cloud Workspace connection. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `failover` (Attributes) Failover configuration for Leader resiliency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace--failover))
- `forward_to_leader_api` (Boolean) If <code>true</code> (default), proxy distributed API traffic through the Leader API server. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address of the Leader Node.
- `ip_whitelist_regex` (String) Regular expression that restricts which IP addresses may connect. Leave empty to allow all.
- `max_active_cxn` (Integer) Maximum number of simultaneous connections to the Leader.
- `max_buffer_bytes` (Integer) Maximum number of bytes to buffer in memory before applying backpressure on the connection.
- `port` (Integer) Port number on which the Leader Node is listening.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol used to connect to the Leader Node.
- `proxy` (Attributes) Optional SOCKS proxy configuration for outbound connections to the Leader. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace--proxy))
- `resiliency` (String) Resiliency mode for the Node's connection to the Leader.
- `subscription_agreement` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the subscription agreement for the Cribl.Cloud Workspace has been accepted. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS settings for the connection to the Leader Node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace--tls))
- `write_timeout` (Integer) Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for a write operation to complete before timing out.

### Nested Schema for `items.instance_settings_schema1.cloud_workspace.failover`

Read-Only:

- `missed_hb_limit` (Integer) Number of missed heartbeats before failover is triggered.
- `period` (String) Duration of the lease period.
- `volume` (String) Minimum data volume that must be processed before a failover candidate is considered eligible.

<a id="nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace--proxy"></a>
<a id="nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--master--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.instance_settings_schema1.cloud_workspace.proxy`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, disable the proxy. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address of the SOCKS proxy server.
- `password` (String) Password for proxy authentication.
- `port` (Integer) Port number of the SOCKS proxy server.
- `type` (Integer) SOCKS proxy type. Use <code>4</code> for SOCKS4 or <code>5</code> for SOCKS5.
- `user_id` (String) Username for proxy authentication.

<a id="nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--cloud_workspace--tls"></a>
<a id="nestedatt--items--instance_settings_schema1--master--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.instance_settings_schema1.cloud_workspace.tls`

Read-Only:

- `ca_path` (String) Filesystem path to PEM-encoded Certificate Authority (CA) certificates.
- `cert_path` (String) Filesystem path to the PEM-encoded certificate chain.
- `certificate_name` (String) Name of a predefined Certificate stored in Cribl.
- `common_name_regex` (String) Regular expression used to validate the TLS peer common name.
- `disabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, disable TLS for distributed communication. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `max_version` (String) Maximum TLS protocol version to accept.
- `min_version` (String) Minimum TLS protocol version to accept.
- `passphrase` (String) Passphrase used to decrypt the PEM-encoded private key.
- `priv_key_path` (String) Filesystem path to the PEM-encoded private key used for TLS client authentication.
- `reject_unauthorized` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, reject connections with unauthorized TLS certificates. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `request_cert` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, request client certificates during TLS handshakes. Otherwise, <code>false</code>.
- `servername` (String) Server name for TLS Server Name Indication (SNI).
